caption:
Custom instructions are NOT the same as training AI to actually know you.

Here's what nobody tells you when you go set up custom instructions in ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini:

You're basically filling out a form for a stranger.

"I'm a marketing manager. I like bullet points. I prefer a casual tone."

Cool. Now you sound like every other marketing manager who filled out that same box.

The AI still doesn't know that you hate when solutions come with 47 caveats. It doesn't know you think in systems before you think in steps. It doesn't know that when you say "quick question" you actually mean "I've been spiraling on this for 3 days."

Custom instructions are a text box.

A thinking profile is a mirror.

bootfile.ai figures out HOW your brain actually works — your reasoning style, how you handle ambiguity, whether you need context before conclusions or just cut straight to answers — and builds something the copy-paste tips on Reddit can't give you.

Still go set up your custom instructions. Seriously, it helps a little.

But don't confuse a sticky note on the fridge with someone who actually knows how you think.

That's the gap bootfile.ai was built to close.
hook: Custom instructions don't teach AI how you think. They just describe you to a stranger.
